text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with Ethereum underperforming slightly, suggesting mild profit-taking across majors while overall sentiment remains in greed territory. Bitcoin dominance at 59.5% is elevated, indicating capital rotation toward the largest asset during this pullback. The 7-day rise in Fear & Greed to 68, paired with $90B in daily volume, suggests conviction underneath the surface—traders are not panicking, and liquidity remains robust enough to absorb the decline.
